title: Compact rail components and adaptive token kit for cost forecast
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design and deliver a compact 'rail' component family and a small adaptive token kit to support dense cost-forecasting and per-route spend widgets in the Redwood Console. Goal: create a set of reusable micro-patterns (compact cards, dense sparklines, condensed rollouts rail) with an associated token subset that supports three density modes (comfortable, compact, dense) without breaking existing pages. This ticket covers UX decisions, Figma components, token mapping guidance, accessibility checks, and a migration handoff brief for Engineering and Product.
acceptance_criteria: Figma library with a new 'CompactRail' component set including: compact-card, metric-row, condensed-toolbar, dense-sparkline, and rollout-pill variants
Adaptive token kit document that defines spacing, type-scale, and icon sizes for three density modes and clear mapping to existing global tokens
Prototype demonstrating a cost-forecast dashboard switcher between density modes with preserved SLO KPI priority ordering
Accessibility audit results for contrast, focus order, and keyboard nav with fixes applied
Engineering handoff doc and GH issue list for token migration and component CSS vars
notes: Decision: implement density as a token layer (density.{comfortable,compact,dense}) that maps to existing spacing and typography tokens to avoid scattering component-level overrides.

Trade-off: tighter density improves information density for power users but increases visual complexity for novices. We provide an explicit toggle and persist preference per user to mitigate confusion.
Performance constraint: dense mode may increase DOM size for list-heavy dashboards. Engineering to evaluate virtualization for long lists (ENG-6210).
Pattern: rails are horizontally stacked micro-layouts intended for side-by-side cost-attribution comparisons; each rail must be able to collapse to a single-line compact row at small widths.
Handoff plan: publish a migration matrix that lists old component -> new CompactRail variant -> required CSS var tokens; include example migration PR template.
